replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used AI tools like Wolfram Alpha for quick calculations and explanations. It helped me understand concepts faster than textbooks, but I still prefer hands-on practice. I found it useful for checking work but not for deep learning.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, write the equation in standard form: ax² + bx + c = 0. Then, calculate the discriminant (b² - 4ac). If positive, two real solutions; if zero, one solution; if negative, complex solutions. Use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(discriminant)] / (2a).

To find stationary points, take the first derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Then, substitute those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they're maxima or minima using the second derivative test.
